name: session_create
description: Create a new session for the current program. The session is appended to the program sessions list with the provided session object.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

session.description: Full session object with date, day, week_number, exercises, session_notes.

name: session_delete
description: Delete a session at a specific date and index (for same-day ordinals).

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

index.description: Zero-based index for same-day session ordinals.

session_id.description: Stable Session.id used when the legacy date/index has changed.

name: session_get
description: Load a single session by date and index (for same-day ordinals). Returns the session with resolved phase object.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

index.description: Zero-based index for same-day session ordinals.

session_id.description: Stable Session.id used when the legacy date/index has changed.

name: session_list
description: List the most recent sessions for a user. Returns session summaries sorted by date descending, then by sort key descending. Use limit to cap the number returned.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return. Default 50, max 200.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to the current program.

name: session_list_full
description: List full session objects (with resolved phases) for a specific program. Returns complete session objects, not summaries.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

name: session_patch
description: Apply a partial patch to a session at a specific date and index. Only the fields in the patch dict are updated; other fields remain unchanged.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

index.description: Zero-based index for same-day session ordinals.

session_id.description: Stable Session.id used when the legacy date/index has changed.

patch.description: Dict with session fields to update. Allowed keys: completed, session_rpe, body_weight_kg, exercises, session_notes, day, week_number.

name: session_patch_by_date
description: Patch a session by date without specifying an index. Finds the matching date and applies the patch. Use when you only have the date, not the ordinal.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

session_id.description: Stable Session.id used when the legacy date has changed.

patch.description: Dict with session fields to update.

name: session_replace
description: Full replace of a session at a specific date and index. Overwrites all session fields with the provided session object.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

index.description: Zero-based index for same-day session ordinals.

session_id.description: Stable Session.id used when the legacy date/index has changed.

name: session_replace_all
description: Replace ALL sessions for a program. Deletes all existing sessions and writes the incoming array. Use with caution — this is a destructive full replace.

pk.description: User partition key. Defaults to env HEALTH_PROGRAM_PK.

program_sk.description: Program sort key. Defaults to current.

sessions.description: Full array of session objects to write.

name: health_get_sessions_range
description: Load all sessions within a date range (inclusive). Returns sessions in date order, each with resolved phase object.
